title: Boyne
html_source:
The River Boyne

famous for the being the site of the Battle of the Boyne which was won by William of Orange beating catholic King James in 1698 and securing a protestant ascendancy in Ireland.

Joyce referred to the peep o' days in Proteus, violent brigands who attempted ethnic cleansing from whom Orangeism is derived.
